prompt: Which pair of instructions should Raj follow before the cart leaves?
promptZh: 推車出發前，Raj 應採取哪一組處置？

options.text: Put K64 on the trial shelf and K63 in the rework bin.
options.zh: 將 K64 放到試驗架，將 K63 放進返工箱。
options.whyZh: K64 是合格的新版品，未經核准須留在試驗架；K63 不合格，須進返工箱。

options.text: Put K64 on the trial shelf and K62 in the rework bin.
options.zh: 將 K64 放到試驗架，將 K62 放進返工箱。
options.whyZh: K64 的處置正確，但 K62 是合格的舊版品，無須返工。

options.text: Put K62 on the trial shelf and K63 in the rework bin.
options.zh: 將 K62 放到試驗架，將 K63 放進返工箱。
options.whyZh: K63 的處置正確，但 K62 是合格的舊版品，可留在組裝推車上。

options.text: Put K62 on the trial shelf and K61 in the rework bin.
options.zh: 將 K62 放到試驗架，將 K61 放進返工箱。
options.whyZh: K62 可留在組裝推車上；K61 已合格，應留在試驗架，不需返工。

explanationZh: K64 是合格的新版品，未經核准須留在試驗架；K63 不合格，須進返工箱。

vocabulary.note: 簽核改變可送往組裝的工法版本；檢驗合格和正式核准不是同一件事。

evidence: Until Engineering signs off, send only accepted old-recipe covers to assembly. Keep accepted revised-recipe covers on the trial shelf.
